EN:'JOIN ME! UNLESS YOU WANT A... ME... ON YOUR HANDS.' ZH:'加入我！除非你想有一个……我……在你手上。'

EN:"Rusty? Full of holes? I don't know!" ZH:'生锈之城？千疮百孔的城市？我怎么会知道？！'

EN:"Oh my. Isn't this... cheery." ZH:'哦，天哪。这儿可真是……“喜气洋洋”啊。'
EN:'That would be a silly name. Off with your... no... Lose Your Head!' ZH:'那真是个愚蠢的名字。好吧，准备……“掉脑袋”吧！'
EN:'Wait, maybe we can do this without any more fighting.' ZH:'等等，也许我们能和平解决这个问题。'
EN:'You said it. Those pants do you no favors.' ZH:'你说的对呀，这些裤子丑爆了。'
EN:"Oh, a corpse! Isn't that pleasant." ZH:'哦，一具尸体！可真“令人愉快”啊。'

EN:"Our team name is... The Only Ones Who Aren't Idiots." ZH:'我们的队名是……“除了我们都是白痴”。'
EN:"You're lucky I didn't shoot you just then..." ZH:'你真幸运，我刚才差点开枪了……'
EN:"Aren't you a little short for a vault dweller? Whatever, I'm done with bedtime stories." ZH:'和一个避难所居民比起来你也太矮了吧？算了，我受够睡前故事了。'
EN:'Too bad you will fail, and your Vault will be ours!' ZH:'可惜你会失败，你的避难所将是我们的！'
EN:'You passed by a run down refueling station on your way back to Filly and you heard odd noises coming from insi' ZH:'你在返回菲利镇的路上经过一个破旧的加油站，听到里面传来的奇怪声音。那会是什么呢？只有进去才能知道！'
EN:"One of your Dwellers won't stop calling themselves “The Pain Train.” Let's make that nickname a reality..." ZH:'你的一位居民一直称自己是“会痛的火车”。我们来让他梦想成真……'
EN:'All Killy No Filly' ZH:'菲利之殇'
EN:"There's a new Raider gang, Euler's Angels, terrorizing the Wasteland's perimeter! Without going on a tangent, " ZH:'有一个新的掠夺者帮派，欧拉的天使，在废土为非作歹！闲话少说，我们得派最聪明的居民去化解这些激进分子的威胁，解决当前的危急局面。'
EN:"You're undercover for the Weekly Exposition, aren't you?" ZH:'你是每周博览会的卧底，对吧？'
EN:'No offense, but this is a dangerous place to be gardening.' ZH:'恕我冒犯，但在这地方搞园艺有点危险啊。'
EN:'A stuffed rabbit nailed to a door. Not really sure WHAT to make of that...' ZH:'一个兔子玩偶钉在门上，这该怎么理解呢？'
EN:'No! You lose, you loser. On top of that, you get to... Lose Your Head!' ZH:'错！你输了，你这个输家。而且，你还要……“掉脑袋”了！'
EN:"Yeeeeaahhh... See, I'm more of a “lover not a fighter” type." ZH:'是……是啊……你看，比起当战士，我更适合当爱人。'
EN:'Three words: Never. Ending. Deathclaws.' ZH:'三个词：永远。结束。死爪。'
EN:'Not unless they sell farmers as meat. Time to... Lose Your Head!' ZH:'除非他们像卖肉一样卖农民。是时候……“掉脑袋”了！'
EN:"Don't you mean “quench your thirst”?" ZH:'你是说“解渴”吗？'
EN:"You ain't getting nothing from me!" ZH:'休想从我这得到什么！'

EN:"Call the doctor! I'm having an infarction! That's a heart attack. Because you're so... Oh, never mind." ZH:'快叫医生！我心肌梗塞了！就是心脏病发作那种。因为你实在太……哦，算了。'
EN:'Not before we get what we came for.' ZH:'除非我们得到我们想要的。'

EN:'Not if we stop you and your unbearable expressions right now.' ZH:'除非我们现在就阻止你和你那令人难以忍受的言论。'
EN:"It isn't much, but it's what we've got! Please enjoy your stay." ZH:'虽然简陋，但这就是我们的一切！请尽情享受在这里的时光。'
EN:"Hey, look! That's gold there, isn't it?" ZH:'嘿，看！那里是金子，对吧？'
EN:'To be or not to be, that is my question…' ZH:'生存还是毁灭，这是我的问题……'
EN:'Fairies? Fairies grant wishes, no? I wish for gold.' ZH:'精灵？精灵能满足愿望，对吧？我许愿要黄金。'
EN:"We can't get any good help these days." ZH:'如今想找点得力帮手可真难。'
EN:"You're *them*, aren't you? I knew this day would come." ZH:'你们是*他们*，对吧？我就知道会有这一天。'
EN:'Looks like we came for nothing then. Our goal was to stop those experiments.' ZH:'看来我们是白跑一趟了。我们的目标是阻止那些实验。'
EN:'There we go. No problemo.' ZH:'搞定。小意思。'
EN:'No way this can go wrong, right?' ZH:'这怎么可能出错，对吧？'

EN:"Unless it's a Ghoul party. Then, it's the perfect atmosphere!" ZH:'除非这是尸鬼派对。那就完美了！'
EN:"We don't care either way. A job's a job. See you there!" ZH:'我们怎么都行。活就是活。到时见！'
EN:"Ah! It's you! Poetic, isn't it? You and Wyatt, erased on the same day." ZH:'啊！是你！多讽刺，对吧？你和怀亚特，同一天被抹去。'
EN:'There are no Synths, fool. This is a trap!' ZH:'哪有什么合成人，蠢货。这是个陷阱！'
EN:"You're not gonna kick mine!" ZH:'你休想踢我的屁股！'
EN:"Real mercenary, aren't you? I suppose I should say thanks…" ZH:'可真够雇佣兵的。我想我该说声谢谢……'
EN:"I can't shake the feeling that this is all staged for us." ZH:'我总觉得这一切都是为我们布置的。'
EN:'Especially when mixed with chems... no wonder they got kicked out.' ZH:'尤其混着药物……难怪他们被赶出来了。'
EN:"Is that a wild Deathclaw? Or part of the hivemind? No matter: it's charging!" ZH:'那是只野生死爪？还是集体意识的一部分？管他呢：它冲过来了！'
EN:'Only after we are out, right? RIGHT? Here goes nothing...' ZH:'得在我们离开之后，对吧？对吧？豁出去了……'
EN:'Well, I never… ' ZH:'哼，真是岂有此理……'
EN:"I'm obviously not talking to the right people. Move along." ZH:'很显然，我找错人了。走开。'
EN:'You are on your own. We just came here to watch you fail.' ZH:'你们自求多福吧。我们只是来看你们怎么惨败的。'
